camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListLineages --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --SrcEntityId 'maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name' --SrcEntityName srcName1 --PageSize 10 --DstEntityName dstName1 --PageNumber 1 --RecentDays 1 --SortBy Name --DstEntityId 'dlf-table::catalog_id:database_name::table_name' --NeedAttachRelationship false
description_en: Queries the upstream and downstream lineage entities of a specified entity in DataWorks Data Map, with an option to include detailed lineage relationship information
description_zh: 查询数据地图中给定实体的上下游血缘实体列表，是否包含具体的血缘关系信息可选
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-lineages --src-entity-id maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name --dst-entity-id dlf-table::catalog_id:database_name::table_name --src-entity-name srcName1 --dst-entity-name dstName1 --need-attach-relationship false --sort-by Name --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --recent-days 1 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLineages

parameters.help_en: The source entity ID. You can use the table or column ID returned by the ListTables or ListColumns operation, or a custom entity ID
parameters.help_zh: 源实体ID，可参考ListTables / ListColumns 接口返回的表/字段ID，以及自定义实体ID
